metadata.title: Cinematic Hallway with Sharp Script Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic sepia-toned photograph of a figure in a hallway, framed by a wide white border and overlaid with aggressive, sharp-angled red script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical sepia-toned photograph of a man leaning against a wall in a dark hallway, positioned on the right side of a larger white canvas. The left side features a wide white margin containing large, aggressive, red hand-drawn lettering with sharp, needle-like terminals that overlap the image edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Asymmetrical balance between the white negative space and the dark photographic frame
Aggressive diagonal lettering cutting across the boundary of the image
High-contrast lighting within the photo creating deep shadows and a focal point on the subject
Color contrast between the muted sepia photo and the saturated red typography
coreInvariants: Sharp, needle-like terminals on all lettering
Asymmetrical white border on the left and top
Low-key lighting with a single overhead source in the photo

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a full-body figure on the far right, scaled to approximately 1/3 of the image height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, open doorway in the center of the photograph acts as a secondary anchor to the large red text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large red text on the left, follow the sharp diagonals into the photograph, and land on the illuminated figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white space on the left and top margins creates a 'frame-within-a-frame' effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white border and dark photo; high saturation contrast between the red text and muted photo.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to sepia tones, white, and a single accent red.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with heavy pressure on downstrokes
Letters are interconnected with jagged, lightning-bolt-like ligatures
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'P' feature long vertical descenders that taper to a point
Horizontal bars are replaced with upward-slanted sharp strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used in two different scales for primary and secondary information.
graphicDevices: Drop shadow on text to lift it from the background

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the jagged, energetic feel of the original lettering.
The specific needle-like points are best achieved through manual vector paths.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned, low-key photograph of a man in a leather jacket leaning against a wall in a dark hallway with an open door. Place this photo on the right side of a vertical white canvas, leaving a wide white margin on the left and top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom red script lettering in the top-left white space, ensuring the sharp terminals of the letters overlap the edge of the photograph. Use a second, smaller instance of the same script in the bottom-left.

verificationChecks: Are the letter terminals sharp and needle-like?
Is the photograph sepia-toned and positioned asymmetrically?
Does the text overlap the photographic frame?
Is the red color saturated against the muted background?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text has a subtle black drop shadow for legibility.
Ensure the hallway perspective leads the eye toward the subject.
Verify the white border is clean and consistent on the left and top.
Confirm the lettering looks hand-drawn and jagged rather than digital.
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Hallway Photo + Asymmetrical White Frame + Sharp Red Script Overlay
